verdict.rationale: Ashby documents a real public API: HTTP Basic auth, candidate creation, application listing with sync tokens, cursor pagination, a job-posting API and signed webhooks. Its official MCP server also exposes search and retrieval across candidates, applications, jobs, interviews, offers, notes, feedback and more. Nothing in the pack claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and only a few write endpoints are evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence of write coverage for scheduling, offers, reports/analytics and admin settings, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
